title: Deterministic formatter binding
summary: A StringTemplate captures a sealed snapshot of formatter-name bindings. Later mutation of the caller registry cannot silently change an existing template, while missing formatter requirements remain inspectable before rendering.
semantics: Registry membership is snapshotted and sealed at template construction.
Formatter objects are not deep-cloned; their deliberate internal state remains formatter authority.
missingFormatterNames observes unsatisfied names without executing formatter code.
validateBindings, render and renderTo fail closed when a required formatter is absent.
renderTo validates bindings before emitting the first segment.
withFormatters creates a new StringTemplate over the same source rather than rebinding an existing object.
